'''Karl Heinrich Hofmann''' (born 3 October 1932<ref name="CV" />), known professionally as '''Karl H. Hofmann''' is a German mathematician and illustrator who is professor emeritus at the [[Technical University of Darmstadt]] (TU Darmstadt). His research is primarily focused on [[topological algebra]] and [[functional analysis]].

==Education==
Hofmann began his first mathematics degree at the [[University of Hamburg]] but transferred to the [[University of Tübingen]] and completed it there. He remained in Tübingen for his master's degree and Ph.D. which was completed in 1958 under supervisor [[Hellmuth Kneser]].<ref name="Gene" >{{MathGenealogy|id=26335}}</ref>

==Career==
Most of Hofmann's work is in [[lie theory]] and [[topological analysis]]. His book with [[Sidney Morris]], ''The Structure of Compact Groups'', has been printed in four editions and is a standard reference for the subject.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Berg |first1=Michael |title=The Structure of Compact Groups {{!}} Mathematical Association of America |url=https://old.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/the-structure-of-compact-groups-0 |website=MAA Reviews |access-date=26 September 2025 |date=22 September 2008}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Netuka |first1=Ivan |last2=Souèek |first2=Vladimír |date=June 1999 |title=Recent books |url=https://ems.press/content/serial-issue-files/13602 |journal=European Mathematical Society Newsletter |volume=32 |pages=33}}</ref>

The [[University of Tübingen]] hired Hofmann as an assistant professor following the completion of his Ph.D. in 1958. He remained at Tübingen until 1963 where he became an associate professor at [[Tulane University]]. He became a full professor two years later an in 1979 the university appointed him as W. R. Irby Professor of Mathematics.<ref name="CV" /> Hofmann supervised 37 doctoral students throughout his fifty-year career.<ref name="Gene" /> In 2013, Hofmann was inducted as a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web |title=2013 Class of Fellows of the AMS |url=https://www.ams.org/fellows_by_year.cgi?year=2013 |website=ams.org |publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]] |access-date=19 September 2025}}</ref>

Alongside his academic career, Hofmann worked as an illustrator. He illustrated multiple books, including ''[[Proofs from THE BOOK]]'', a [[Leroy P. Steele Prize]] winner.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Aigner |first1=Martin |author-link1=Martin Aigner |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-662-57265-8 |title=Proofs from THE BOOK |last2=Ziegler |first2=Günter M. |author-link2=Günter M. Ziegler |publisher=Springer |year=2018 |isbn=978-3-662-57265-8 |edition=6 |pages=i-viii |doi=10.1007/978-3-662-57265-8 |postscript=. Illustrated  by Karl H. Hofmann.}}</ref> He has also created posters for [[TU Darmstadt]]'s colloquiums since 1983.<ref>{{cite web |title=Karl Heinrich Hofmann |url=https://www.mathematik.tu-darmstadt.de/fb/personal/details/karl_heinrich_hofmann.en.jsp |website=TU Darmstadt |access-date=26 September 2025 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Kolloquiumsposter |url=https://www.mathematik.tu-darmstadt.de/fb/aktuelles/kolloq/galerie/index.de.jsp |website=Mathematik – TU Darmstadt |access-date=26 September 2025 |language=de}}</ref>
